question: In January 2022, which State Government has extended its integrated initiative for the empowerment of persons with disabilities (PwDs) - the Bhima Bhoi Bhinnakhyama Samarthya Abhiyan (BBSA) – for the next five years?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Odisha.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Bhima Bhoi Bhinnakhyama Samarthya Abhiyan (BBSA):-**

 
 
• In **January 2022**, the **Odisha government **announced the **extension** of its** Bhima Bhoi Bhinnakhyama Samarthya Abhiyan (BBSA)** for the **next five years.**
 
• This initiative is aimed at** empowering persons with disabilities** (PwDs) in the state.
 
• The BBSA was launched in** 2018 **and has been successful in providing various benefits to PwDs, including** financial assistance, skill development, and employment opportunities.**
 
• The extension of BBSA for the next five years will help in reaching out to more **PwDs **and providing them with the **necessary support and resources.** 
 
• Odisha is among the leading states in India when it comes to **promoting the welfare and rights of PwDs.**
 
• The state has various schemes and programs in place to ensure their **inclusion in society.**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Manipur:**

 
 
• The government of Manipur has launched various schemes and programs for the welfare of PwDs, including **financial assistance, education, and employment opportunities. **
 
 
 
• **Jharkhand:**
 
 
• The Jharkhand government has launched the **Mukhyamantri Divyangjan Udyamita Vikas Abhiyan (MDUVA)** to promote entrepreneurship among PwDs.
 
 
 
• **West Bengal:**
 
 
• The West Bengal government has launched various schemes and programs for the welfare of PwDs, including** financial assistance, education, and employment opportunities.**
